messages.content: Alright, the user wants a minimal Three.js scene, so I'll stick to the absolute basics: a single cube geometry with a standard material, a point light to cast some soft shadows and define the form, and a simple rotation animation in the render loop. I'll keep the scene graph lean, skip unnecessary post-processing, and just let the colored cube spin against a dark void to make the light pop. Three.js is perfect here since we can set this up with a few lines and let the WebGLRenderer handle the rest.
